_about: Public-domain William Jones of Nayland (1726-1800), Hutchinsonian divine, for the Word Hoard: his Theological and Miscellaneous Works (London: Rivington, 1826, six volumes, with a short account of his life) and the Memoirs of George Horne (1799), from Internet Archive scans. Not Sir William Jones the orientalist. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 42 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
